title: VeloraOS 1.10.47 - GPU Acceleration Enforcement
releaseNotes: Restores GPU-first inference for every Ollama-backed Chat, Coding and image/vision request when a compatible GPU is available.
Explicitly requests maximum compatible GPU layer offload for normal generation, continuations, retries and diagnostics.
Adds an Ollama GPU configuration self-heal during install/update, including render/video permissions.
Restores Vulkan acceleration configuration for AMD and Intel GPUs while keeping NVIDIA on Ollama's CUDA backend.
CPU remains a safe fallback only when GPU acceleration is unavailable or the model cannot fully fit in VRAM.
